title: Blessing Skin Extension Importer
subtitle: Import third-party Blessing Skin plugin tables into your installed SkinLoom plugins.
uninstallNoticeTitle: On-demand migration plugin (safe to uninstall after completion)
uninstallNotice: Core accounts, players, textures, and settings are migrated by SkinLoom's built-in setup wizard. This plugin only imports optional BS plugin extension tables (invitation_codes, mojang_verifications, textures_description). Once finished, you may disable or uninstall (--purge) this plugin cleanly.
emptyHistory: No migration jobs have been run yet.
